name: Canterbury
verdict: Canterbury is a brand of Pentland Brands, part of family-owned Pentland Group; in Japan the national-team jerseys are made by Tokyo-listed Goldwin. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: the Canterbury brand is owned by Pentland Brands (Pentland Group, a UK family business); the Japan national-team business is run by Canterbury of New Zealand Japan, whose jerseys are designed and manufactured by Tokyo-listed Goldwin Inc. No state or fund in either chain → none. Kit maker of the Japan 2025/26 home jersey, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers.
